sections.thesis: Treasury yields rose again as dimming prospects for a US-Iran deal added to worries about the inflation outlook.

sentences.text: Treasury yields rose again as dimming prospects for a US-Iran deal added to worries about the inflation outlook.
President Trump signalled an end to Vice-President JD Vance's push for an Iran peace deal, posting that the US does not need one.
His comments sent oil higher and accelerated the Treasury selloff, alongside a weak 30-year auction, with markets pricing a 75% chance of a Fed hike in January.

sections.thesis: The yen weakened to 160 against the dollar as renewed US inflation worries strengthened the dollar, drawing a warning from Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama against rapid, one-sided moves.

sentences.text: The yen weakened to 160 against the dollar as renewed US inflation worries strengthened the dollar, drawing a warning from Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama against rapid, one-sided moves.
She said Japan would coordinate closely with the US Treasury and respond appropriately.
Tokyo spent a record $50 billion in one day intervening over the summer, but the yen's downtrend has not reversed.

sections.thesis: Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, before closing down 5.4%.

sentences.text: Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, before closing down 5.4%.
The Nasdaq closed down 0.4% after falling about 1.5%, while rivals AMD and Broadcom advanced.
Nvidia named finance chief Colette Kress interim CEO, with no clear successor in place.

sections.thesis: Oil futures gave up early losses and closed higher after Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran.

sentences.text: Oil futures gave up early losses and closed higher after Trump said the US does not need a deal with Iran.
Brent rose 3.3% to $95.82 a barrel and WTI settled up 2.6% at $88.74, shrugging off strong builds in US crude, gasoline and diesel stocks.
Gold fell $113.60 to settle at $3,889.40 an ounce, a 52-week low, on rising bond yields and a stronger dollar.
